snippet.title: Growing Pains Story Time with LilyPichu | Overwatch
snippet.description:
The MEKA Squad attempts to adjust after D.Va's departure to Overwatch, and D.Mon questions her ability to lead...

Join LilyPichu, the voice actor behind D.Mon, for a reading of our newest comic, ‘Growing Pains.’ 

After D.Va leaves Busan to join up with Overwatch, the MEKA Squad is struggling. But as the Gwishin adapt their tactics after every conflict and with the team’s most difficult battles is still on the horizon. D.Mon must grapple with how to lead the MEKA Squad without her.

Play Overwatch Season 3, available now. 

Read by LilyPichu as D.Mon
Written by Alyssa Wong 
Art by  Velinxi
Letters by  AndWorld Design         
Cover by  Velinxi
Design by Sophie Erb

Senior Director, Story & Franchise Development: Venecia Duran    
Senior Manager, Writing & Books: Matthew Cohan    
Editorial: Shannon Watters
Editorial Supervisor: Chloe Fraboni
Senior Brand Artist: Sophie Erb

Production:
Brianne Messina 
Qiannan Zhang  
Takayuki Shimbo 
JT Torrea

Game Team Consultation:  
Jeff Chamberlain 
Miranda Moyer 
Nesskain 
Dion Rogers
Jude Stacey 
Joshi Zhang



Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, including Nintendo Switch™ 2
